title: Industrial Asset Reliability and Engineering Standards Agent

approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Hard-won plant experience sits in non-conformance reports, maintenance history and the heads of the people who have been there longest. Engineers designing today need the current standard, not the one that was current when the document was filed.
script.vo02: Design review is slow, and an inconsistency is easy to miss by eye.
script.vo03: It reads Lessons learned and non-conformance reports, Maintenance history. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. And it can mine lessons learned and non-conformance reports for the pattern, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: An engineer asks about a recurring failure on one line. The agent reads the maintenance history and the non-conformance reports, and returns the pattern with the evidence behind it.
script.vo05: Asked for a maintenance strategy, the agent proposes an ordered plan - the checks to bring forward, the parts to hold, and the intervals worth revisiting, each tied back to the record.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent names the engineering standard that governs the change, flags where the historical record is thin, and marks what a reviewer must confirm.
script.vo_payoff: Engineers get the plant's own experience and the current standard together, at the moment of the decision.
script.vo_helps: The result? Retrievable plant experience, quicker design review, and the current standard in front of the engineer when it matters.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
